nonmonotonicity_rationale: NRGPT energy recurrence is position-dependent by design; frozen-prefix energy at position 0 reflects a single-token EBM state without recurrent context, so adding context shifts the energy landscape downward. Expected in recurrent EBMs; does not indicate architectural failure.
paper_v6_framing: Report in paper-v6 Section 4 as: energy non-monotonicity at position 0 is expected behavior in recurrent EBMs (Type b: causal-context shift), not an architectural flaw.
